## Teaching Overview

My teaching experience spans [Lovely Professional University](https://www.lpu.in/), [IISER Mohali](https://www.iisermohali.ac.in/), and [Chandigarh University](https://www.cuchd.in/), covering undergraduate and postgraduate Physics students as well as undergraduate engineering students. This experience includes both theory and laboratory teaching across a broad range of Physics topics. My broader experimental-physics research background has also shaped an approach to teaching that connects conceptual understanding and mathematical reasoning with problem-solving and hands-on experimental learning.

## Curriculum & Faculty Development

At [Lovely Professional University](https://www.lpu.in/), played an active role in designing and developing undergraduate Physics curricula, courses, and pedagogical tools, alongside participation in university-level course management.

Faculty development formed a particularly important part of this work. Conducted lectures, seminars, and laboratory demonstrations for **Physics faculty members**, with an emphasis on effective approaches to undergraduate Physics teaching and the integration of conceptual, theoretical, and experimental learning.

Received formal recognition from the Vice-Chancellor, **Dr. Vijay Gupta**, for faculty-development activities.

## Teaching Philosophy

Effective Physics teaching should integrate conceptual understanding, mathematical reasoning, structured problem-solving, and hands-on experimental learning. Theoretical ideas become more meaningful when students can connect mathematical descriptions to observable physical phenomena, test assumptions experimentally, and understand the relationship between idealized models and real measurements. This approach aims to develop both physical intuition and technical competence while encouraging students to reason independently, ask critical questions, and approach unfamiliar problems systematically.
